question.description: Literal case-insensitive whitespace-separated terms; all terms match across entry text, session title and stored refs. No model call.

since.description: Inclusive RFC 3339 timestamp or YYYY-MM-DD (UTC start of day).

until.description: Inclusive RFC 3339 timestamp or YYYY-MM-DD (UTC end of day).

limit.description: Maximum matching public or private entries contributing to this result.
